senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; √או, v. foreg.; cmp. חבל, חַיִל, חזקה a. next w.)possession, power.
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Avodah Zarah 3:16">Tosef. Ab. Zar. III, 16</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Avodah Zarah 4">IV</cite>, beg.) <he>כתב לו או̇נו̇</he> if he (the seller of the slave) wrote to him (gave him in writing) the liberty of his disposal of himself, i.e. that the slave, if he should run away from the buyer, would not be claimed by him who sold him; <cite ref="Gittin 43b:8">Git. 43ᵇ</cite> <he>כתב עליו אונו</he> (read <he>אליו</he> or <he>לו</he>).
<cite ref="Gittin 43b:9">Ib.</cite> <he>מאי אונו</he> what means ‘his own possession’? Ans. He wrote to him this, ‘If thou run away from him (the purchaser), I have nothing to do with thee.

<cite ref="Gittin 85b">Ib. 85ᵇ</cite>.—[<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Bava Metzia 1:5:2">Y. B. Mets. I, end, 8ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Kiddushin 1:5:7">Y. Kidd. I, 60ᶜ</cite> <he>אונו</he>, v. <cite ref="A00736"><he>אוֹנִי</he></cite>.] V. <cite ref="A00735"><he>אוֹנָה</he></cite>.
